rows.definition: inkernel_expert_spill.go is the agent planner seam that resolves a loaded model’s graded MoE expert-spill placement once from operator intent and measured device budget, then applies that placement to each request session.
rows.distinction: The SERVE-SIDE LIFECYCLE BRIDGE for graded expert spill, not InKernelPlanner (the whole native request planner) and not its Qwen prefill-chunk control.

rows.definition: InKernelQwenQ4KPrefillChunkConfigError is the typed error retained when an explicit resident-Qwen Q4_K prefill chunk size lies outside 128..8192; a targeted request returns it before tokenization or model execution.
rows.distinction: The FAIL-CLOSED ERROR VALUE for an invalid bound, not QwenQ4KPrefillChunkTokens (the requested planner setting) and not InKernelPlanner (the planner retaining it).

rows.definition: kvSpanEvict is the planner-scoped enablement bit set only when FAK_INKERNEL_KVMMU opts in on the CPU model path; guarded eviction code checks it before rebuilding a session and evicting a quarantined tool-result K/V span.
rows.distinction: The ENABLEMENT GATE for the live planner bridge, not KVSpanEvictor (the public quarantine-bridge interface) and not KVCache.Evict (the model cache mutation it eventually invokes).
